title: Lives Plugin
description: This plugin adds limited lives to your server!
body: This mod implements a configurable lives system that tracks and manages each player’s life count. Players begin with a set number of lives, lose one on death, and are automatically banned when their total reaches zero. Lives can be withdrawn as items, redeemed to increase a player’s count, or obtained through a special craftable life item. A revive beacon provides an interface for selecting and restoring banned players with one life. The mod also updates tab-list name colors to reflect current life totals, giving players a clear visual indicator of their status.
